summary: Wheeler County lookout site: 1930 crow's nest and tent cabin, 66-foot L-6 tower in 1941, removed or destroyed in the 1950s; no source describes it today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the 1941 tower and cabin were removed in the 1950s; firelookout.com says they were destroyed in the 1950s. The story reports both wordings and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Brief's record had no build, staffing or removal events; those come from the register, firelookout.com and Weebly, which agree on the 1930 crow's nest and the 1941 tower. Only the removal wording differs (removed vs destroyed). Weebly's 1929 tower is a plan in a newspaper item; no source read says it was built. The 1941 tower's date is consistent across the register and firelookout.com. Two-source identity is solid: coordinates N 44.464170 W 120.084540 and elevation 6,194 ft match the brief. No source read describes the site today, and none states access, so access is omitted. The register has a 1934 panorama and a 1942 photo caption (Howard Verschoor collection); no image URLs were captured, so no photos were added. Search returned no further Peterson Point pages.
